'''Nippet''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] who lived on the [[Forest/Legends|forest]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. She was the daughter of [[Lumat/Legends|Lumat]] and [[Zephee/Legends|Zephee]] and the sister of [[Latara/Legends|Latara]] and [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]].

As a [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]], Nippet (along with Wiley) accidentally helped their babysitters [[Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]] find a large quantity of rainbow berries just before the Harvest Moon Festival, in a year when no one had been able to find any of the beloved berries. The woklings were celebrated by the whole village, as a result.<ref name=":0">''[[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]]''</ref>

Nippet was also once captured during the [[Stranglethorn crisis]] but was saved by Kneesaa, Wicket, and the [[Trome]]s.<ref name="1-11">{{Ewoks|The Three Lessons}}</ref> In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the evening before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Nippet was present in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] when the Ewoks captured the [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. She watched as [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], pretending to be the Ewoks' [[Golden One/Legends|god]], recounted the earlier years of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Nippett_cartoon.jpg|thumb|175px|Nippet as she appeared in [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]]]
The name Nippet was first used for this wokling in the mini-storybook [[The Baby Ewoks' Picnic Surprise]], in 1984, just predating its first use on screen in the animated series the following year.<ref name=":0" />

Nippet was one of six 8-inch plush woklings made by [[Kenner Products|Kenner]] based upon the six woklings seen in ''Return of the Jedi''. While the character names of [[Malani]], Nippet, and [[Wiley (Ewok)|Wiley]] were established prior in the [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']] television series, the other three&mdash;[[Mookiee]], [[Leeni]], and [[Gwig]]&mdash;have yet to be attributed to their respective characters seen in ''Return of the Jedi''.
